title: JS: cards carry their real id, focus ring matches by id
description: The shared click() helper (every skin's card markup) now also emits data-id, and window.PlaydockSetFocus matches by that id instead of position - fixes the stale doc comment that already claimed data-id existed, and lays the real groundwork for a focus ring that survives a filtered card list.
commit_message: Match PlaydockSetFocus by data-id instead of index
